Zainab bakes every order fresh when it comes in, then posts it with Royal Mail Tracked. Most orders are with you in 3–5 days.
Yes, anywhere in the UK. Delivery is free on orders over £35.
Yes. Build your box with a base, your chips and up to three of Zainab’s 11 flavours, and we split the box evenly between them.
Oats (gluten), eggs, milk and fenugreek, a legume that may cross-react with peanut or soy allergies. Made in a kitchen that also handles tree nuts. The vegan base has no eggs or dairy.
No. Everything is made with natural, wholesome ingredients and baked to order.
They’re made from everyday food ingredients. Fenugreek isn’t right for everyone, so if you or your baby are sensitive to it, or you have a health condition, check with your midwife or GP first.
We make nourishing food, not medicine, so we can’t promise that. If you’re worried about your supply, your midwife, health visitor or a lactation consultant (IBCLC) is the right person to talk to.
Yes. Choose “It’s a gift” at checkout, add her address and your note, and we’ll leave the prices off the packing slip.
You get a printed card in an envelope to give at the shower. She redeems it online once baby arrives and builds her own box, so every cookie is fresh.
Yes, for baby showers, markets and events. Tell us numbers and dates through the contact page.
Build your box and choose every 2 or 4 weeks. You get 10% off every box, free delivery on 20 and 40 packs and a guaranteed slot in every bake.
Any time, online. You can also skip a box or swap flavours before it’s baked.

Fenugreek may cross-react with peanut and soy allergies in sensitive people. Made in a kitchen that also handles tree nuts, so not suitable for anyone with a tree nut allergy.
no eggs or dairy. Still contains oats, flaxseed and fenugreek, and the same tree nut advice applies. Some flavours and chips may add allergens; each is listed on the product page.
